brief:
Settlers made an attempt to steal horses in the village of Tiyaasir, located east of Tubas in the northern West Bank, Shehab Wire reported. The incident is part of a broader pattern of livestock theft and property crimes attributed to Israeli settlers in Palestinian communities across the occupied territory.

Details about the circumstances of the attempted theft, including the number of animals targeted and whether residents were able to prevent the loss, were not immediately disclosed. The incident underscores ongoing tensions over settlement encroachment and resource access in rural Palestinian areas.
